question: give me top 10 product by contribution
sql_query:
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (
    1 - od.discount
  )) AS total_contribution
FROM order_details AS od
JOIN products AS p
  ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  total_contribution DESC
LIMIT 10;
summary: This data displays the top 10 products ranked by their total contribution. "Côte de Blaye" is the leading contributor, significantly outperforming other products with over 140,000 in contribution. The contributions generally decrease down the list, with the tenth product, "Rössle Sauerkraut," contributing around 25,000.
